de: War of 1812: American frigate USS President, commanded by Commodore Stephen Decatur, is captured by a squadron of four British frigates.

dz: 财务总监罗伯特·莫里斯(英语:Robert Morris)向美国国会发表讲话,建议设立国家薄荷和十进制硬币.
de: Superintendent of Finance Robert Morris addresses the U.S. Congress to recommend establishment of a national mint and decimal coinage.

t: 新康涅狄格州（今佛蒙特州）宣布独立。
te: New Connecticut (present-day Vermont) declares its independence.
dz: 美国独立战争：新康涅狄格州（今佛蒙特州）宣布独立。

t: 大英博物馆对外开放.

dz: 大英博物馆对外开放.
de: The British Museum opens to the public.

te: Russia cedes Livonia to the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
dz: 亚姆-扎波尔斯基休战:俄罗斯将利沃尼亚割让给波兰-立陶宛联邦.
de: Truce of Yam-Zapolsky: Russia cedes Livonia to the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

te: Elizabeth I is crowned Queen of England and Ireland in Westminster Abbey, London.
dz: 伊丽莎白一世在伦敦威斯敏斯特会所被加冕为英格兰和爱尔兰女王.
de: Elizabeth I is crowned Queen of England and Ireland in Westminster Abbey, London.

dz: 法国国王弗朗西斯一世授予让-弗朗索瓦·罗贝尔瓦勒(Jean-François Roberval)一个解决新法兰西行省(加拿大)问题的委员会,并规定"天主教信仰"的传播.
de: King Francis I of France gives Jean-François Roberval a commission to settle the province of New France (Canada) and provide for the spread of the "Holy Catholic faith".

dz: 亨利八世国王颁发专利证书，将英格兰教会最高领袖的头衔纳入其皇家头衔。
de: King Henry VIII issues letters patent incorporating the title Supreme Head of the Church of England into his royal title.

t: 奥托在罗马夺取了政权,自称为"罗马皇帝",开始仅仅统治了三个月.
te: Otho seizes power in Rome, proclaiming himself Emperor of Rome, beginning a reign of only three months.
dz: 奥托在罗马夺取了政权,自称为"罗马皇帝",开始仅仅统治了三个月.
de: Otho seizes power in Rome, proclaiming himself Emperor of Rome, beginning a reign of only three months.
